LanguageData.DMSE.EW.Throttle.GizmoDesc: Set the power level. Lower power shortens range and weakens the effect but draws less and is harder for anti-radiation missiles to pick. Standby stops the device completely and still draws idle power.
LanguageData.DMSE.EW.Jammer.Inspect: Jamming radius {0} world tiles, strength {1}, covering {2} hostile tracks
LanguageData.DMSE.EW.Jammer.CommsBlocked: Comms consoles on this map are disabled while jamming.
LanguageData.DMSE.EW.Jammer.CommsBlockedMessage: A jammer is transmitting: comms consoles on this map are disabled.
LanguageData.DMSE.EW.Jammer.ShowRingDesc: Jamming radius {0} tiles (red ring on the world map). Jump to this colony on the world map.
LanguageData.DMSE.EW.Jammer.GuidanceDenied: {0} lost its seeker to jamming and will fall on inertial guidance.
LanguageData.DMSE.EW.Jammer.JammedOut: {0} lost guidance to {1}'s jamming and went down off-map.
LanguageData.DMSE.EW.Jammer.ArrivedInertial: Seeker jammed: the missile is falling on inertial guidance.
LanguageData.DMSE.EW.Alert.CommsJammedDesc: A jammer is transmitting on this map, so its comms consoles cannot be used. Set the jammer to standby or switch it off to restore comms.
LanguageData.DMSE.EW.Tab.NoPower: No power: remote control and rules cannot be changed. The current rules stay in effect.
LanguageData.DMSE.EW.Tab.SilencedWarning: Emissions silence is on: radars and jammers are off.
LanguageData.DMSE.EW.Roe.AutoEngageDesc: When off, targets are still detected and alerts still fire, but interceptors are not launched. Close-in weapons keep firing.
LanguageData.DMSE.EW.Roe.PolicyAllDesc: Self-defense only engages missiles aimed at this colony or an ally. Passing missiles are left alone.
LanguageData.DMSE.EW.Roe.LargestFirst: Largest target first (off: first come, first served)
LanguageData.DMSE.EW.Roe.LargestFirstDesc: When channels run short, engage the largest radar signature first instead of the soonest arrival.
